aas.reason: IDTA specifies an RDF serialisation; the published ontology file has not yet been reviewed.

bfo.reason: BFO 2020 OWL files are published in the BFO-2020 repository.

bot.reason: BOT is published as OWL at its w3id namespace.

brick.reason: Brick releases include the ontology in Turtle (repository).

cco.reason: CCO OWL files are published in its repository.

dcat.reason: W3C publishes DCAT 3 as RDF at its namespace.

dcterms.reason: DCMI publishes the terms as RDF.

digital-reference.reason: OWL/Turtle files are published in its repository; licence to confirm before processing.

dmtf-cim.reason: DMTF CIM is a MOF/UML schema, not an RDF/OWL ontology.

eclass.reason: ECLASS releases, including the RDF serialisation, require a commercial licence.

eli.reason: Distribution format and licence of the ontology files not yet reviewed.

emmo.reason: EMMO OWL/Turtle files are published in its repository.

geosparql.reason: OGC publishes the GeoSPARQL ontology as RDF.

goodrelations.reason: GoodRelations is published as OWL at its namespace (legacy).

gs1-webvoc.reason: GS1 publishes the vocabulary as JSON-LD (requires a JSON-LD parser).

iec-cim.reason: IEC standard (UML information model) sold by IEC; profiles such as CGMES are not OWL ontologies.

ieee-aur.reason: Public OWL availability under the IEEE SA open-source programme not yet confirmed.

ieee-cora.reason: A CC BY 4.0 OWL conversion of CORA is published in a public repository; the standard itself is sold by IEEE.

ieee-pos.reason: Specified in the IEEE 1872-2015 text (sold by IEEE); no public machine-readable module known.

ieee-rparts.reason: Specified in the IEEE 1872-2015 text (sold by IEEE); no public machine-readable module known.

ieee-rtr.reason: IEEE 1872.1-2024 text is sold by IEEE; no public machine-readable ontology known.

ifcowl.reason: The former IFC4 ontology page no longer resolves; current distribution not yet reviewed.

iof-core.reason: IOF publishes OWL files for each release.

iso-15926-14.reason: ISO technical specification sold by ISO; no public OWL distribution known.

obi.reason: OBI OWL files are published in its repository.

oeo.reason: OEO OWL files are published in its repository.

oriont.reason: No public source identified (see the record's verification notes).

owl-time.reason: W3C publishes OWL-Time as OWL at its namespace.

prov-o.reason: W3C publishes PROV-O as OWL at its namespace.

saref4inma.reason: ETSI publishes the ontology in Turtle at its namespace.

skos.reason: W3C publishes SKOS as RDF at its namespace.

step-ap242.reason: STEP AP242 is an EXPRESS information model, not an RDF/OWL ontology.

sumo.reason: SUMO is authored in SUO-KIF; the OWL translation has not yet been reviewed.

sumo-cora.reason: Part of the IEEE 1872-2015 axiomatisation; no separate public artefact known.
